name: Ye Mi Shu De Li Zong Hen Nian Ren
overview: Five years ago, Ye Zhi Meng became Li Xing Yuan's secretary and lover in order to save her seriously ill relatives. She became Qiu Hua's substitute and was well-behaved and sensible beside him. When she saw the news of Li Xing Yuan and Qiu Hua's marriage on the news, Ye Zhi Meng felt exhausted physically and mentally. Her remaining dignity made her resign and want to end the relationship, but she found out that she was pregnant. She decided to keep the child a secret. Ye Zhi Meng's sudden rebellion made Li Xing Yuan feel out of control, and the relationship between the two became complicated.
